An anchor wrapping a block that holds another anchor records its destination once, not twice

```swift title="Swift"
import HtmlToMarkdown

let _options = try HtmlToMarkdown.conversionOptionsFromJson("{}")
let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convert(html: "<a href=\"/o\"><div><a href=\"/i\">Inner</a></div></a>", options: _options)
debugPrint(result.content as Any)
```
